references.text: Here are mentioned the three sons of Levi – Gershon, Kohath and Merari – who are the origin of the three main Levitical clans listed in Numbers 26:57.
This verse mentions the sons of Levi – Gershon, Kohath and Merari – as they went down to Egypt with Jacob, confirming the three branches of the Levitical line.
The first census of the Levites with a listing of the clans of Gershon, Kohath and Merari and their subfamilies.
Detailed description of the three Levitical clans – the Gershonites, Kohathites and Merarites – with their responsibilities in tabernacle service.
Repeats that the sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath and Merari, confirming the three main branches of the Levitical line.
The genealogy of the Levites with Gershon, Kohath and Merari and their descendants, including Aaron and Moses.
David organized the Levites into groups according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath and Merari.
